results.rule: Every commit message follows conventional commits, `type(scope): subject`.
results.step:
- name: Every commit message follows conventional commits
  run: |
    python3 - <<'PY'

    import json, os, re, sys
    pr = json.load(open(os.environ["GITHUB_EVENT_PATH"], encoding="utf-8"))["pull_request"]
    pat = re.compile(r"^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|perf|test|build|ci|chore|revert)(\([^)]*\))?!?: .+")
    bad = [c["message"] for c in pr["commits"] if not pat.match(c["message"].split("\n")[0])]
    if bad:
        for m in bad:
            print("not conventional: %s" % m)
        sys.exit(1)

results.rule: Pushing directly to `main` is forbidden.
results.step:
- name: Pushing directly to the default branch is forbidden
  run: |
    python3 - <<'PY'

    import json, os, sys
    ev = json.load(open(os.environ["GITHUB_EVENT_PATH"], encoding="utf-8"))
    branch = ev["repository"]["default_branch"]
    bad = []
    if ev["branch_protection"].get(branch, {}).get("allow_direct_push"):
        bad.append("branch protection allows direct push to %s" % branch)
    for p in ev.get("push_events", []):
        if p["ref"] == "refs/heads/%s" % branch:
            bad.append("direct push to %s by %s" % (branch, p["actor"]))
    if bad:
        print("\n".join(bad))
        sys.exit(1)

    PY

results.rule: Force pushing to a protected branch is forbidden.
results.step:
- name: Force pushing to a protected branch is forbidden
  run: |
    python3 - <<'PY'

    import json, os, sys
    ev = json.load(open(os.environ["GITHUB_EVENT_PATH"], encoding="utf-8"))
    protected = set(ev["branch_protection"])
    bad = [b for b, s in ev["branch_protection"].items() if s.get("allow_force_push")]
    bad += ["forced push to %s by %s" % (p["ref"], p["actor"]) for p in ev.get("push_events", [])
            if p.get("forced") and p["ref"].replace("refs/heads/", "") in protected]
    if bad:
        print("\n".join(str(b) for b in bad))
        sys.exit(1)

results.rule: No security step carries `continue-on-error: true`.
results.step:
- name: No security step carries continue-on-error: true
  run: |
    python3 - <<'PY'

    import glob, re, sys
    SEC = re.compile(r"(?i)(secur|secret|scan|audit|vuln|sast|codeql|trivy|gitleaks|trufflehog)")
    bad = []
    for path in sorted(glob.glob(".github/workflows/*.yml") + glob.glob(".github/workflows/*.yaml")):
        text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
        blocks = re.split(r"(?m)^(?=\s*-\s+name:)", text)
        for block in blocks:
            head = block.strip().split("\n")[0]
            if SEC.search(head) and re.search(r"(?m)^\s*continue-on-error:\s*true", block):
                bad.append("%s: %s" % (path, head.strip()))
    if bad:
        for b in bad:
            print("neutered security step -> %s" % b)
        sys.exit(1)

    PY

- name: Every pull request runs at least one secret-scanning step

    import glob, re, sys
    SCAN = re.compile(r"(?i)(gitleaks|trufflehog|detect-secrets|secret[ _-]?scan|ggshield)")
    found = False
    for path in sorted(glob.glob(".github/workflows/*.yml") + glob.glob(".github/workflows/*.yaml")):
        text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
        if re.search(r"(?m)^\s*pull_request:?", text) and SCAN.search(text):
            found = True

        sys.exit(1)

results.rule: No file is larger than 5 MB.
results.step:
- name: No file is larger than 5 MB
  run: |
    python3 - <<'PY'

    import os, sys
    LIMIT = 5 * 1024 * 1024
    bad = []
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk("."):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d != ".git"]
        for name in files:
            path = os.path.join(root, name)
            if os.path.getsize(path) > LIMIT:
                bad.append((path, os.path.getsize(path)))
    if bad:
        for path, size in bad:
            print("%s is %d bytes, limit is %d" % (path, size, LIMIT))
        sys.exit(1)

results.rule: Every source directory has a corresponding test directory.

- name: Every source directory has a corresponding test directory
  run: |
    python3 - <<'PY'

    import os, sys
    if not os.path.isdir("src"):
        sys.exit(0)
    if not os.path.isdir("tests") and not os.path.isdir("test"):
        print("src/ exists but there is no test directory")

    if bad:
        for d in bad:
            print("src/%s has no %s/%s" % (d, root, d))
        sys.exit(1)
